logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the complexes was determined using the flask-shaking method where n-octanol and an aqueous sodium chloride solution were used as the organic and aqueous phase, respectively. n-Octanol was presaturated with an aqueous solution of sodium chloride (0.9% w/v) by swirling at 45 rpm for 24 h. The complex was dissolved in the isolated organic phase at a concentration of 50 μM. An equal volume of aqueous sodium chloride solution (0.9% w/v) was added, and the mixture was swirled for 30 min at 45 rpm. The solution was then centrifuged, and the amounts of complex in both layers were determined by emission spectroscopy.
